## Safety checklist

- [ ] No secrets, keys, or personal data added.
- [ ] No fabricated sources, citations, phone numbers, or URLs.
- [ ] If this touches `data/sources`, `rules/`, or the safety gate: governance lead requested as reviewer.
- [ ] New env vars documented in `.env.example`.
- [ ] Schema changes are a new migration (no edits to merged migrations).
